title: Wild Project

services.name: Rentals at wild project
services.desc: wildprojectTV gives artists and creators across theater, dance, film, spoken word, music, and visual arts the resources to transform their theater content into impactful films, live-streams, and theater-on-film using wild project’s 89-seat theater as a production sound stage. WAY DOWN follows ALEX, a struggling non-binary photographer and the bass player for an even more struggling band in New York City, where they live with their girlfriend/bandmate TYLER. Broke, queer, almost-30 year old artists navigate life and heartache in the city’s most ass-kicking neighborhood. It’s about to go down.Starring: iris menas, Aury Krebs, Alexis Floyd, Deon’te Goodman, Jake Austin Robertson & Monique
